As a Java Developer, you'll support the design, development, modernization, and sustainment of mission-critical applications supporting federal government operations. Working as part of an Agile delivery team, you'll develop and enhance enterprise applications, improve system performance, and contribute to the delivery of secure, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.

  
  

You'll collaborate with business analysts, architects, testers, and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions. In addition to developing new capabilities, you'll support application modernization initiatives, resolve production issues, and contribute to continuous improvement efforts throughout the software development lifecycle.

  
  

This role extends beyond coding. You'll help analyze requirements, evaluate technical approaches, identify opportunities for modernization, and support the successful deployment of enterprise solutions across complex environments.

  
  

Join us. The world can't wait.

* Experience troubleshooting application issues and supporting production environments
* Ability to document technical designs, application functionality, and development activities
* Top Secret clearance
* Bachelor's degree

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Tetrad Digital Integrity (TDI) is a leading-edge cybersecurity firm with a mission to safeguard and protect our customers from increasing threats and vulnerabilities in this digital age.  
  
TDI is seeking a DevOps Engineer to support a brand-new Agile development team at the forefront of federal IT modernization, delivering real digital transformation where it matters most. This is a rare ground-floor opportunity to architect, build, and integrate cutting-edge infrastructure solutions in support of some of our nation's most sensitive and critical missions.  
  
***This is a fully onsite opportunity requiring a daily commute to the Washington, DC area. An active TS/SCI security clearance is required.***  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop automated CI/CD build/deployment pipelines using Jenkins (CloudBees), Artifactory, Kubernetes (OpenShift), Docker, Ansible and Bitbucket.
* Assist with the deployment, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates/upgrades of Kafka and Elastic clusters and environments.
* Configure applications to integrate network data into an Elastic (ELK) stack hosted in an AWS cloud environment.
* Configure applications in accordance to meet DoD security standards, including DoD Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs).
* Develop, and maintain centralized dashboards and observability solutions to monitor application health, performance, availability, security posture, infrastructure utilization, and cloud spend across environments.
* Implement proactive monitoring, alerting, and automation using metrics, logs, traces to improve incident detection, operational visibility, root cause analysis, and system reliability.
